notes.title: Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]A big thanks to everyone who played the game and shared feedback - I’ve used a lot of it to improve the game![/p][p][/p][p]Changes[/p][list][*][p]Reworked multiselect: you can now easily drag with the cursor to select multiple nodes. Then move any of the selected nodes to move them all.[/p][/*][*][p]Renders are no longer wiped when [spoiler]upgrading the system.[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]Added a few extra tips in the tutorial to point out some less obvious features.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed some typos.[/p][/*][*][p]Filled in a few missing pixels on sprites.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That’s all for now.[/p][p]- Nordin[/p]
